svg.title: Shopped horizontal lockup — transparent, for dark backgrounds
Shopped — Make room for the everyday.
svg.desc: Shopped household shopping, pantry, and recipes. Cross-platform text names Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS without making a release availability claim.

svg.title: Shopped features — shopping, pantry, recipes
svg.desc: Three equally weighted Shopped product areas: shopping lists and cart, pantry tracking and use-soon items, and recipes with serving scaling and ingredient handling.

svg.title: Shopped household loop
svg.desc: A household loop from shopping lists and cart, to pantry, recipes and cooking. Pantry transitions into shopping only when Shopping and pantry is enabled in Settings.

svg.title: Shopped household sharing across devices
svg.desc: Illustrative device diagram. Enter the same household code on both devices. Share over the same Wi-Fi while both apps are open, or over the internet while both apps are open. Contents are sent as encrypted copies; the household code itself is not sent over the network.
